text:
Type: medallion area rug
Use: anchoring an entry or seating area; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: traditional, mid-century modern, farmhouse
Materials: woven synthetic fibers, low flat pile
Colors: dark grey, ivory, light grey
Shape: rectangular, distressed central floral medallion field, ivory floral border, thin flat profile, medium small
Feel: classic, muted, timeless
Goes with: brick or wood floors, rustic wood, white walls, greenery; farmhouse or traditional rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Mid-Century Modern Blooming Medallion Rug, 4' x 6', Dark Grey
product.description: Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Jute Imported This dark grey blooming medallion rug adds cool, contemporary style to your transitional spaces. It's a modern remake of a classic oriental pattern made of stain resistant fiber that is a smart option for active households. Highly durable update of a classic design Machine woven. Made in Turkey. 100% polypropylene Durable and long-lasting 4' x 6' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle.
